test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: Multiplayer side started
test.hint: Ticks itself when the game starts the multiplayer side (host or player).

test.title: An edit shows on the other PC
test.hint: One of you moves or adds a few points. The other sees them within a second.

test.title: Same spot: one of you is told
test.hint: Both edit the same few points at the same moment. One edit goes through; the other is told who is working there (ticks itself).

test.title: Undo after the other changed your spot
test.hint: You move a point, the other moves it again, you press undo: it skips that move and names them (ticks itself).
